name: lifted-ai
description: Lifted.AI — a coverage-first session generator with an articulated 3D movement rig.

scripts.build: rm -rf www && mkdir -p www && cp index.html manifest.json capacitor.js www/ && cp -R icons www/
scripts.sync: npm run build && npx cap sync ios && npm run verify
scripts.ios: npm run sync && npx cap open ios
scripts.verify: cmp -s index.html ios/App/App/public/index.html && echo 'ios assets in sync' || (echo 'STALE: run npm run sync' && exit 1)
